entries.title: Genesis 17:1
segments: And when Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, I [am] the Almighty God! Walk before Me and be perfect.

entries.title: Genesis 17:2
segments: And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.

entries.title: Genesis 17:3
segments: And Abram fell on his face. And God talked with him, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 17:4
segments: As for Me, behold! My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many nations.

entries.title: Genesis 17:5
segments: Neither shall your name any more be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham. For I have made you a father of many nations.

entries.title: Genesis 17:6
segments: And I will make you exceedingly fruitful, greatly so, and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come out of you.

entries.title: Genesis 17:7
segments: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your seed after you in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your seed after you.

entries.title: Genesis 17:8
segments: And I will give the land to you in which you are a stranger, and to your seed after you, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. And I will be their God.

entries.title: Genesis 17:9
segments: And God said to Abraham, And you shall keep My covenant, you and your seed after you in their generations.

entries.title: Genesis 17:10
segments: This is My covenant, which you shall keep, between Me and you and your seed after you. Every male child among you shall be circumcised.

entries.title: Genesis 17:11
segments: And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin. And it shall be a token of the covenant between Me and you.

entries.title: Genesis 17:12
segments: And a son of eight days shall be circumcised among you, every male child in your generations; he that is born in the house, or bought with silver of any stranger who [is] not of your seed.

entries.title: Genesis 17:13
segments: He that is born in your house, and he that is bought with your silver, must be circumcised. And my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

entries.title: Genesis 17:14
segments: And the uncircumcised male child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.

entries.title: Genesis 17:15
segments: And God said to Abraham, As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name [shall be] Sarah.

entries.title: Genesis 17:16
segments: And I will bless her, and give you a son also of her. Yes, I will bless her, and she shall be [a mother] of nations, kings of people shall be from her.

entries.title: Genesis 17:17
segments: And Abraham fell upon his face and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall [a child] be born to him that is a hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear?

entries.title: Genesis 17:18
segments: And Abraham said to God, Oh that Ishmael might live before You!

entries.title: Genesis 17:19
segments: And God said, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son indeed. And you shall call his name Isaac. And I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

entries.title: Genesis 17:20
segments: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall father twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

entries.title: Genesis 17:21
segments: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this set time in the next year.

entries.title: Genesis 17:22
segments: And He left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

entries.title: Genesis 17:23
segments: And Abraham took his son Ishmael, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his silver; every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskins in the same day, even as God said to him.

entries.title: Genesis 17:24
segments: And Abraham [was] ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

entries.title: Genesis 17:25
segments: And his son Ishmael [was] thirteen years old [when] he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

entries.title: Genesis 17:26
segments: In the same day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.

entries.title: Genesis 17:27
segments: And all the men of his house, that were born in the house, and bought with silver of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
